text:
/do-beads run 2026-05-12: re-adding human after Mark's de-labeling because the epic keeps surfacing as the top ready bead, and per the /do-beads command spec a review-shaped epic must be delegated to bd-review-loop. That delegation deadlocks identically to yesterday's 17:08-17:43Z run (review-readonly tries 'RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --workspace --no-deps' → permission overlay returns action=ask → non-interactive session hangs).

The deadlock isn't fixed by removing 'human' on the parent; it's fixed by either:
(a) closing the epic as converged (yesterday's bd-spin recommended this — only opinion-tagged P3+ and mechanical-scaffolding sub-beads remain),
(b) extending the review-readonly agent's bash allowlist to include 'cargo doc *' and 'RUSTDOCFLAGS=* cargo doc *', or
(c) some other resolution Mark prefers.

Mark: drop 'human' again if you want the /do-beads loop to try delegating once more (it will deadlock again until (a) or (b)). Until then, this label prevents the loop from spinning.

The 4 open P2 examples sub-beads (.17.2-.17.5) are being unblocked separately by removing the inverted blocks-edges that yesterday's triage put on .17 — that's a bd quirk where bidirectional parent-child + blocks edges trigger spurious blocked-detection on the children. Confirmed by comparing with JMAP-sc1b.107 (parent-child only, ready) and JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3 (blocks-only via .4.11, blocked by .4.11 not by parent).
